content: Even after all this time the sun never says to the earth, 'You owe me.' Look what happens with a love like that, it lights the whole sky.
author: Hafez
explanation: Hafez reveals the sublime nature of unconditional divine love. Unlike human relationships that often keep balance sheets of resentment and expectation, true cosmic love gives endlessly without demanding repayment, radiating warmth that illuminates the world.
practicalInsight: Perform an act of genuine generosity or kindness today without letting the recipient know, seeking zero praise or reciprocity.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your relationships are you keeping score, and what would it feel like to love with the unconditional generosity of the sun?
